stage_driver.name: THE STAGE DRIVER
stage_driver.note: Four beats and he is gone. Everything else he said in v2 -- what the town is, Mott's strike, whether anyone has found it, how long the search has run -- is redistributed into town, where the sources contradict each other and no character in Act I gives a complete or correct account.

hob.name: HOB
hob.note: Beat 9 is his crossing, and doc 17 note 1 is explicit that "Wouldn't stand there" is not a hint -- there is nothing wrong with where Thad is standing. Hob says small true-sounding things to strangers. A player who moves has lost nothing and a player who stays has lost nothing.

unwritten: Doc 17 note 0: Hob may be asked about Ezra Pike, once -- "Pike's up the hill." It is true, it is his only useful sentence in Act I, and it has no tree to live in yet. Extracted here so it is on file rather than only in the doc.

beats.description: Title over the ridge at night. Consolation below as scattered lamps in a great deal of darkness
beats.note: Longing, not comedy. No act card here

beats.description: Cut closer. The coach halted, the driver unloading. Thad steps down, straightens his coat, looks at the town
"My name is Thaddeus Grubb. I have come to Consolation to make my fortune." — "Course you have."

lines.speaker: thad
lines.line: My name is Thaddeus Grubb. I have come to Consolation to make my fortune.

beats.description: "Four dollars?" — Thad checks — "Four dollars." — "You've all got four."
Thad asks after Ezra Pike — "Ask the undertaker. He knows everybody."

lines.speaker: stage_driver
lines.line: Ask the undertaker. He knows everybody.

beats.description: The case goes in the mud. "Hotel's five." — "I have four." The driver climbs aboard
beats.note: The material problem. He leaves before Thad can ask anything more

beats.description: The coach recedes east. A badly tuned piano, faint, from the town. ACT CARD
beats.note: PART ONE — In Which Our Hero Is Robbed, and Enjoys It
beats.actCard: PART ONE — In Which Our Hero Is Robbed, and Enjoys It

beats.description: Hob's lamp crosses. "Wouldn't stand there." / "Why not?" / "No reason."
beats.note: Now the second strange encounter, carrying no exposition
